title: Antimicrobial Peptides Conference
level: Researchers (as stated on the conference page)
about: The 2027 Gordon Research Conference "Antimicrobial Peptides" takes place from 31 January to 5 February 2027 at Renaissance Tuscany Il Ciocco in Lucca (Barga), Italy. Applications are submitted through the conference page on grc.org.
